statement: A line returns on 2 or more spreads in 9 of 14 books with text (e.g. 'Come back, cat!', 'Are we there yet?', 'Good night, Monu.', Bohlale's 'I think I will give up because…'); the other 5 repeat a structure or a sound pattern instead of a line.

scope.population: contemporary open-licence picture books: Book Dash (13), African Storybook (2), StoryWeaver/Pratham Books (1); 2014-2025

analyst_note:
2026-10-14: Best Friends and An Unexpected Adventure (wordless) reviewed for this claim. Best Friends repeats a refusal line on 3 spreads, then reverses it by action rather than changing the line. The wordless book is not counted.
2026-10-15: Book Dash: Khumo, Come Back Cat, Ga Mohana support; Bathtub Safari and Feathered Friends repeat structure only. African Storybook: Bohlale supports (near-quit line x3), Chicken and Millipede repeats a comparison structure. StoryWeaver: Good Night, Monu supports (refrain at pp 2, 5, 13 answers the child's good nights; comfort function, fits m003).

magicpaper.current: repetition is measured as a defect to avoid (PROSE_PRODUCTION_GUIDE.md)
magicpaper.suggested: Distinguish deliberate refrains (a line the listener can join, changed once at the end) from accidental repetition before treating all repetition as a defect.
